title: 鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗~Welding inspection of major steel joints
focus: 以焊接程序、預熱與熱輸入控制、施工停留點與非破壞檢測，確保厚板全滲透焊接頭能承受設計力與地震、疲勞需求~Securing thick-plate complete-joint-penetration joints for design, seismic and fatigue demands through procedures, preheat and heat-input control, hold points and nondestructive testing
summary: 從巨型梁柱接頭與箱型柱續接的傳力出發，說明 1994 年 Northridge 地震焊接接頭脆斷的教訓、厚板層狀撕裂與氫致冷裂、焊接程序與銲工資格、焊接順序與收縮、品管與品保停留點、超音波檢測幾何、尺寸目視檢查、缺陷修補與焊道紀錄，並以 Alexander L. Kielland 平台、I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋與舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段為實例。~Starting from force transfer in mega beam–column joints and box-column splices, explain the lessons of brittle weld fractures in the 1994 Northridge earthquake, lamellar tearing and hydrogen cold cracking in thick plate, welding procedures and welder qualification, weld sequence and shrinkage, quality-control and quality-assurance hold points, ultrasonic testing geometry, dimensional visual inspection, defect repair and weld records, with the Alexander L. Kielland platform, the I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge and the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge East Span as examples.

units.anchor: 梁翼板全滲透開槽焊~Beam-flange CJP groove weld
units.title: 巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類~Force transfer and weld classification in major joints
units.mechanism: 巨型梁柱接頭、桁架節點與箱型柱續接中，彎矩大多以翼板拉壓力偶傳遞，受拉翼板的全滲透開槽焊必須發揮與母材相同的強度；腹板與加勁板的填角焊則主要承受剪力。焊縫的重要性不只取決於尺寸，而取決於失效後果：位於耐震系統塑性區、承受反覆拉力或疲勞的焊縫，會被歸為需求關鍵焊縫，適用更嚴格的韌性、檢驗與紀錄要求。檢驗計畫因此要先把每一道焊縫分類，而不是一律同樣對待。~In mega beam–column joints, truss nodes and box-column splices, moment travels mostly as a tension–compression couple in the flanges, and the complete-joint-penetration (CJP) groove weld on the tension flange must develop the full strength of the base metal, while fillet welds on webs and stiffeners mainly carry shear. A weld's importance depends less on its size than on the consequence of its failure: welds in the yielding zones of seismic systems or under repeated tension or fatigue are classed as demand-critical, with stricter toughness, inspection and record requirements. An inspection plan therefore starts by classifying every weld rather than treating all alike.
units.model: 翼板力 F = M/(d − t_f)。M = 2,000 kN·m、梁深 d = 0.9 m、翼板厚 t_f = 0.03 m：F = 2,000/0.87 ≈ 2,299 kN；翼板 300×30 mm，面積 9,000 mm²，平均應力 σ = 2,299,000/9,000 ≈ 255 MPa，已接近 Q345 或 A572 Gr. 50 鋼材降伏強度的四分之三，焊縫任何缺陷都直接位於高應力區。數值為教學假設。~Flange force F = M/(d − t_f). With M = 2,000 kN·m, beam depth d = 0.9 m and flange thickness t_f = 0.03 m, F = 2,000/0.87 ≈ 2,299 kN; a 300×30 mm flange of 9,000 mm² carries σ = 2,299,000/9,000 ≈ 255 MPa, about three quarters of the yield strength of a 345 MPa steel, so any weld flaw sits in a highly stressed zone. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在設計圖與施工圖上以符號標出每一道焊縫的類型（全滲透、部分滲透、填角）、受力方向、是否為需求關鍵焊縫與對應的非破壞檢測等級，製成焊縫清冊；檢驗人員以清冊核對現場，確保沒有焊縫被遺漏或降級。~Mark on design and shop drawings the type of every weld (CJP, partial-penetration, fillet), its stress direction, whether it is demand-critical and its required NDT level, compiled into a weld register; inspectors check the site against the register so no weld is missed or downgraded.
units.failure: 若施工圖把受拉翼板全滲透焊誤標為一般焊縫，只做目視檢查，內部未熔合或夾渣就會留在接頭中，在地震或強風的大拉力下由缺陷處脆性斷裂，裂縫可能貫穿翼板並延伸到柱翼板。~If shop drawings mislabel a tension-flange CJP weld as an ordinary weld inspected only visually, internal lack of fusion or slag stays in the joint and, under large seismic or wind tension, starts a brittle fracture that can run through the flange into the column flange.
units.misconception: 焊縫外觀平整光滑，就代表內部品質良好。~A smooth, even weld surface means the weld is sound inside.
units.practice: 結構設計者必須在圖說中明確指定需求關鍵焊縫與各焊縫的檢驗等級，不能留給製造廠判斷；焊縫清冊列為施工圖審查的必要文件，未經結構工程師核定不得開始製造。~The structural designer must specify demand-critical welds and the inspection level of every weld on the drawings rather than leave it to the fabricator; the weld register is a required submittal in shop-drawing review, and fabrication may not start before the structural engineer approves it.

units.anchor: 背墊板與焊接扇形孔~Backing bars and weld access holes
units.title: Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓~Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake
units.mechanism: 1994 年 1 月 17 日規模 6.7 的 Northridge 地震後，工程師在多棟鋼造抗彎矩構架建築中發現梁柱焊接接頭脆性斷裂，SEAOC、ATC 與 CUREE 同年組成 SAC 聯合團隊，在 FEMA 與加州緊急服務辦公室資助下研究至 2000 年。常見問題包括：留在原處的背墊板與未熔合根部形成類似裂縫的缺口，焊材韌性不足，焊接扇形孔幾何造成應力集中，以及檢驗難以看到下翼板根部。之後的規範要求需求關鍵焊縫使用有韌性保證的焊材、移除背墊板並清根補焊或加填角焊。~After the magnitude 6.7 Northridge earthquake of 17 January 1994, engineers found brittle fractures in welded beam–column joints of many steel moment-frame buildings; SEAOC, ATC and CUREE formed the SAC Joint Venture that year and, funded by FEMA and the California Office of Emergency Services, studied the problem until 2000. Common issues included backing bars left in place with unfused roots acting as crack-like notches, weld metal of low toughness, stress concentrations at weld access holes, and inspection that could hardly see the root of the bottom flange. Later codes required demand-critical welds with toughness-rated filler metal, backing removal with back-gouging and reweld, or a reinforcing fillet.
units.model: 根部缺口近似邊緣裂縫，K = 1.12σ√(πa)。翼板應力 σ = 300 MPa：未熔合深 a = 1 mm 時 K ≈ 1.12×300×√(π×0.001) ≈ 18.8 MPa√m；a = 5 mm 時 K ≈ 42.1 MPa√m，已接近低韌性焊材在低溫下的斷裂韌性量級。數值為教學假設。~Treat the root notch as an edge crack, K = 1.12σ√(πa). With flange stress σ = 300 MPa, an unfused depth of a = 1 mm gives K ≈ 1.12×300×√(π×0.001) ≈ 18.8 MPa√m, while a = 5 mm gives K ≈ 42.1 MPa√m, approaching the fracture toughness of low-toughness weld metal at low temperature. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 需求關鍵焊縫的焊材須有規定溫度下的 Charpy 衝擊韌性證明，背墊板移除後以清根、磁粉檢測確認根部無缺陷再補焊；完成後以超音波檢測全長，特別注意下翼板根部與扇形孔周圍。~Demand-critical welds need filler metal certified for Charpy impact toughness at specified temperatures; after removing the backing bar, back-gouge, confirm a sound root by magnetic particle testing and reweld, then ultrasonically test the full length with special attention to the bottom-flange root and around the access hole.
units.failure: Northridge 後檢查發現，許多斷裂接頭從外觀幾乎看不出異常，必須拆除防火被覆與裝修才看得到裂縫；這說明地震後的鋼構檢查若只做目視巡查，會嚴重低估損傷。~Post-Northridge inspections found that many fractured joints looked almost normal from outside and cracks appeared only after fireproofing and finishes were removed, showing that post-earthquake steel inspections relying on walk-through visual checks badly underestimate damage.
units.misconception: 留下焊接背墊板可以增加接頭強度，因此不需要移除。~Leaving the weld backing bar in place adds strength, so it never needs removing.
units.practice: 耐震抗彎矩接頭的細部（扇形孔形狀、背墊板處理、補強填角焊）要採用經試驗驗證的接頭型式，任何現場變更都須經結構工程師核准；地震後的檢查計畫要預先指定拆除被覆的抽查接頭位置。~Seismic moment-connection details (access-hole shape, backing treatment, reinforcing fillets) must follow test-qualified connection types, and any field change needs the structural engineer's approval; post-earthquake inspection plans should name in advance which joints will have fireproofing removed for checks.

units.anchor: 厚板 Z 向性能與預熱~Through-thickness properties and preheat
units.title: 厚板層狀撕裂與氫致冷裂~Lamellar tearing and hydrogen cracking in thick plate
units.mechanism: 巨型接頭常用 50 mm 以上的厚板，焊縫收縮會在板厚方向拉扯母材；若鋼板內有平行於表面的非金屬夾雜，就可能沿夾雜層狀撕裂。另一種危險是氫致冷裂：焊材或潮濕帶入的氫、硬化的熱影響區與高拘束應力同時存在時，裂縫可能在焊後數小時至數天才出現。對策是選用 Z 向性能保證的鋼板、使用低氫焊材並保持乾燥、依碳當量與板厚預熱並控制層間溫度。Alexander L. Kielland 平台事故調查也在相關板件中發現層狀撕裂與冷裂。~Major joints often use plates thicker than 50 mm, and weld shrinkage pulls the base metal through its thickness; non-metallic inclusions lying parallel to the surface can then cause lamellar tearing. Another danger is hydrogen cold cracking: when hydrogen from consumables or moisture, a hardened heat-affected zone and high restraint stress coincide, cracks may appear hours to days after welding. Remedies are plates with guaranteed through-thickness properties, dry low-hydrogen consumables, preheat chosen by carbon equivalent and thickness, and controlled interpass temperature. The Alexander L. Kielland investigation also found lamellar tearing and cold cracks in the plates involved.
units.model: 碳當量 CE = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15。C 0.16、Mn 1.45、Cr 0.05、Mo 0.02、V 0.05、Ni 0.10、Cu 0.15（%）：CE = 0.16 + 0.242 + 0.024 + 0.017 ≈ 0.44。熱輸入 HI = 60·V·I/(1,000·v)，30 V、300 A、行進速度 300 mm/min：HI = 1.8 kJ/mm；碳當量偏高且板厚大時，需提高預熱並把熱輸入控制在焊接程序範圍內。數值為教學假設。~Carbon equivalent CE = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15. With C 0.16, Mn 1.45, Cr 0.05, Mo 0.02, V 0.05, Ni 0.10 and Cu 0.15 (%), CE = 0.16 + 0.242 + 0.024 + 0.017 ≈ 0.44. Heat input HI = 60·V·I/(1,000·v); at 30 V, 300 A and 300 mm/min travel, HI = 1.8 kJ/mm; a high carbon equivalent in thick plate calls for higher preheat, with heat input held inside the procedure range. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 核對鋼板出廠證明的化學成分、Z 向斷面收縮率與超音波探傷結果，焊前以超音波掃描接頭附近母材找出分層；焊接時以接觸式溫度計或測溫筆在距焊道規定距離處確認預熱與層間溫度，並記錄電流、電壓與行進速度以計算熱輸入。~Check mill certificates for chemistry, through-thickness reduction of area and ultrasonic plate testing, and scan the base metal near the joint ultrasonically before welding to find laminations; during welding, confirm preheat and interpass temperature with a contact thermometer or temperature crayon at the specified distance from the joint, and log current, voltage and travel speed to compute heat input.
units.failure: 在冬季未預熱就焊接厚板，或焊條暴露在潮濕空氣中過久，焊後隔天才在熱影響區出現細微裂縫；若在完工當下就做完非破壞檢測並放行，這些延遲裂縫會被包覆在防火被覆或混凝土內。~Welding thick plate in winter without preheat, or with electrodes left too long in damp air, lets fine cracks appear in the heat-affected zone a day later; if NDT is done immediately and the joint released, these delayed cracks are sealed inside fireproofing or concrete.
units.misconception: 鋼板越厚越安全，所以厚板接頭不需要特別的焊接控制。~Thicker plate is always safer, so thick-plate joints need no special welding control.
units.practice: 厚板接頭的焊接程序要明訂最低預熱、最高層間溫度、熱輸入範圍與焊材烘乾保管要求；對淬火回火等高強度鋼，最終目視與非破壞檢測應在焊後規定的等待時間（例如 48 小時）後進行。~Thick-plate procedures must state minimum preheat, maximum interpass temperature, heat-input range and consumable drying and storage; for quenched-and-tempered high-strength steels, final visual inspection and NDT should follow a specified waiting time after welding, such as 48 hours.

units.anchor: 焊接程序規範與程序評定紀錄~WPS and PQR
units.title: 焊接程序與銲工資格~Welding procedures and welder qualification
units.mechanism: 焊接程序規範（WPS）規定製程、焊材、接頭形狀、焊接位置、預熱與熱輸入等變數；它必須是規範預審合格的程序，或以程序評定紀錄（PQR）的試板經拉伸、彎曲與衝擊試驗證明可行。改變重要變數（例如焊材類別、熱輸入範圍或預熱）就需要重新評定。銲工則須以同等或更困難的位置與接頭考試合格，並維持資格有效。檢驗員的第一項工作是確認每一道焊縫都有對應的有效程序，且由合格銲工施焊。~A welding procedure specification (WPS) fixes the process, consumable, joint geometry, position, preheat and heat input; it must be prequalified by the code or proven by a procedure qualification record (PQR) whose test plates pass tension, bend and impact tests. Changing an essential variable, such as consumable class, heat-input range or preheat, requires requalification. Welders must pass tests in the same or more difficult positions and joints and keep their qualifications current. The inspector's first task is to confirm that every weld has a valid procedure and is made by a qualified welder.
units.model: PQR 焊道金屬在 −29°C 要求平均 ≥ 27 J（20 ft·lbf），單一試片不得低於要求值的 2/3 = 18 J。三支試片 34、29、19 J：平均 (34 + 29 + 19)/3 ≈ 27.3 J ≥ 27 J，最低 19 J ≥ 18 J，合格；若最低為 17 J，即使平均合格仍判不合格。數值為教學假設。~A PQR weld metal requiring an average of at least 27 J (20 ft·lbf) at −29°C, with no single specimen below two thirds of it, 18 J, gives 34, 29 and 19 J: average (34 + 29 + 19)/3 ≈ 27.3 J ≥ 27 J and minimum 19 J ≥ 18 J, a pass; a minimum of 17 J fails even with a passing average. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 開工前審查每份 WPS 與其 PQR 試驗報告，核對焊材型號、板厚範圍與位置是否涵蓋實際接頭；現場抽查銲工資格證與識別號碼，並比對焊道上的銲工標記與每日焊接紀錄，確認是同一人。~Before work starts, review each WPS against its PQR test reports and confirm that consumable, thickness range and positions cover the actual joints; on site, spot-check welder certificates and ID numbers and compare weld stamps with daily welding logs to confirm the same person made the weld.
units.failure: 為了趕工改用較粗焊線或提高電流，熱輸入超出程序範圍，熱影響區韌性下降；若沒有人發現程序已被改變，試驗合格的 PQR 就不再代表實際焊縫的性能。~Switching to a larger wire or higher current to save time pushes heat input outside the procedure range and lowers HAZ toughness; if nobody notices the change, the passed PQR no longer represents the actual welds.
units.misconception: 銲工經驗豐富就可以不按焊接程序施焊。~An experienced welder does not need to follow the welding procedure.
units.practice: 每個焊接工作站張貼適用的 WPS 摘要，檢驗員每班至少抽測一次電流、電壓與行進速度；程序任何變更都須重新提送審查，未經核准的變更所做的焊縫一律列為不符合項目。~Post the applicable WPS summary at every welding station and have the inspector check current, voltage and travel speed at least once per shift; any procedure change must be resubmitted for review, and welds made under an unapproved change are recorded as nonconformances.

units.anchor: 對稱分段焊接順序~Balanced weld sequence
units.title: 焊接順序、收縮與殘餘應力~Weld sequence, shrinkage and residual stress
units.mechanism: 大型全滲透焊冷卻時沿焊道橫向收縮數公釐，若接頭被周圍構件拘束，收縮變成殘餘拉應力，可能造成裂縫或使構件位置偏移。超高層箱型柱的現場續接，每一個接頭的收縮累積起來會影響樓層標高與垂直度；桁架節點多方向焊接時，焊接順序則決定變形方向。因此要以對稱、分段、由拘束大處往拘束小處的順序施焊，並在製造長度中預留收縮補償。~Large CJP welds shrink several millimetres transversely as they cool; if surrounding members restrain the joint, the shrinkage turns into residual tensile stress that can crack the weld or pull members out of position. In supertall box-column field splices the shrinkage of every joint accumulates into floor-level and plumbness errors, and in truss nodes welded from several directions the sequence decides which way the joint distorts. Welds are therefore made symmetrically, in segments, from the most restrained toward the least restrained area, with shrinkage allowances built into fabricated lengths.
units.model: 對接焊橫向收縮經驗式 S ≈ 0.2·A_w/t + 0.05·d。焊道斷面積 A_w = 1,300 mm²、板厚 t = 60 mm、根部間隙 d = 3 mm：S ≈ 0.2×1,300/60 + 0.05×3 ≈ 4.3 + 0.15 ≈ 4.5 mm。若柱高方向有 20 個續接，累積約 20×4.5 ≈ 90 mm，必須在柱段長度中預留。數值為教學假設。~An empirical transverse shrinkage for butt welds is S ≈ 0.2·A_w/t + 0.05·d. With weld area A_w = 1,300 mm², plate thickness t = 60 mm and root opening d = 3 mm, S ≈ 0.2×1,300/60 + 0.05×3 ≈ 4.3 + 0.15 ≈ 4.5 mm. Twenty splices up a column add about 20×4.5 ≈ 90 mm, which must be allowed for in segment lengths. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以首件或代表性接頭量測焊前焊後的間隙、長度與垂直度，比較實際收縮與預估值並修正後續補償量；箱型柱續接完成後量測柱頂標高與傾斜，與施工測量控制網比對，偏差超過允許值時停止上層施工並檢討。~Measure gap, length and plumb before and after welding on a first or representative joint, compare actual shrinkage with the estimate and correct later allowances; after each box-column splice, survey column-top level and tilt against the construction control network, stopping upper work for review if deviations exceed tolerances.
units.failure: 若四面箱型柱同時由一側焊完再焊另一側，柱段會向先焊的一側傾斜；拘束很高的節點一次焊滿而不分段，冷卻時在焊根或熱影響區產生橫向裂縫，往往要到超音波檢測才發現。~Welding one face of a four-sided box column completely before the opposite face tilts the segment toward the first side; filling a highly restrained node in one go without segmenting can crack the root or heat-affected zone transversely on cooling, often found only by ultrasonic testing.
units.misconception: 焊接順序只影響外觀與變形，不會影響接頭強度。~Weld sequence affects only appearance and distortion, never joint strength.
units.practice: 製造廠應提交焊接順序計畫，標示每一道焊縫的施焊順序、分段長度與銲工配置（例如對邊兩人同時施焊），並由結構工程師審查；現場不得因方便而改變順序，變更須重新核准。~The fabricator should submit a weld-sequence plan showing the order, segment lengths and welder arrangement for every weld (for example two welders working opposite faces at once), reviewed by the structural engineer; the sequence may not be changed on site for convenience without re-approval.

units.anchor: 焊前、焊中與焊後檢查點~Before, during and after-weld checks
units.title: 品管、品保與檢驗停留點~Quality control, quality assurance and hold points
units.mechanism: 焊接品質主要在焊接過程中決定，完工後的非破壞檢測只能抽查結果。製造廠的品管人員負責焊前組立間隙、坡口角度、清潔與預熱，焊中逐層檢查與清根，焊後外觀與尺寸；業主委託的品保人員則獨立觀察與抽驗。2005 年舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段工程的焊接品質遭前銲工與檢驗員指控後，FHWA 委託民間檢驗單位切取鋼塊做實驗室分析，報告三塊試件的焊道符合或超過規範，這種獨立驗證正是品保的角色。~Weld quality is decided mainly during welding; NDT after completion only samples the result. The fabricator's quality-control staff check fit-up gap, bevel angle, cleanliness and preheat before welding, each pass and back-gouging during welding, and appearance and size afterwards, while the owner's quality-assurance staff observe and sample independently. In 2005, after former welders and inspectors alleged poor welding on the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge East Span project, FHWA had private inspectors cut sections for laboratory analysis and reported that welds from three pieces met or exceeded specifications, an example of exactly this kind of independent assurance.
units.model: 某批 400 道全滲透焊，抽驗 10% 即 40 道超音波，發現 3 道拒收：拒收率 3/40 = 7.5%。若規格規定拒收率超過 5% 時改為 100% 檢測，其餘 360 道須全部補驗；若只有 1 道拒收（2.5%），可維持抽驗比例。數值為教學假設。~In a lot of 400 CJP welds, a 10% sample of 40 is ultrasonically tested and 3 are rejected: a reject rate of 3/40 = 7.5%. If the specification switches to 100% testing above 5%, the remaining 360 welds must all be tested; with only 1 rejection (2.5%) the sampling rate could stay. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以檢驗計畫表列出每類焊縫的觀察項目（組立、預熱、清根、外觀）與頻率，並設置停留點：例如清根後須經檢驗員確認才能繼續、全部檢驗合格前不得塗裝或包覆；每個停留點以簽名與時間記錄。~Tabulate in the inspection plan the observation items (fit-up, preheat, back-gouge, appearance) and frequency for each weld class, and set hold points such as inspector release after back-gouging before welding continues, and no painting or encasement before all tests pass; record each hold point with signature and time.
units.failure: 若品管與品保由同一單位擔任，或品保人員只看報告不到現場，焊工趕工時省略清根或預熱也不會被發現；之後即使超音波抽驗合格，也只代表被抽到的焊縫，而非整批品質。~If one party performs both quality control and quality assurance, or assurance staff read reports without visiting the shop, a hurried welder skipping back-gouging or preheat goes unnoticed; a passing ultrasonic sample then represents only the welds sampled, not the lot.
units.misconception: 只要完工後的超音波抽驗合格，焊接過程的檢查就可以省略。~If post-weld ultrasonic sampling passes, in-process inspection can be skipped.
units.practice: 品保檢驗員應由業主直接委託並獨立於製造廠，擁有停工權；檢驗計畫明訂抽驗比例與拒收率升級規則，所有拒收焊縫都追溯到銲工與班次，作為擴大檢驗的依據。~Quality-assurance inspectors should be hired directly by the owner, independent of the fabricator and empowered to stop work; the inspection plan fixes sampling rates and escalation rules on reject rates, and every rejected weld is traced to its welder and shift as the basis for expanded testing.

units.anchor: 超音波斜角探頭掃描~Angle-beam ultrasonic scanning
units.title: 超音波與相位陣列檢測~Ultrasonic and phased-array testing
units.mechanism: 厚板全滲透焊與 T 型接頭的內部缺陷主要靠超音波檢測：斜角探頭把聲波以固定折射角送入鋼板，遇到未熔合、夾渣或裂縫就反射回來，由聲程與角度換算缺陷深度與位置，再以參考靈敏度判定是否拒收。相位陣列超音波（PAUT）以多個晶片電子控制聲束角度，一次掃描就得到斷面影像，並可留下可重新檢視的數位紀錄。焊前也要掃描母材找出可能導致層狀撕裂的分層。~Internal flaws in thick-plate CJP welds and T-joints are found mainly by ultrasonic testing: an angle-beam probe sends sound into the plate at a fixed refracted angle, lack of fusion, slag or cracks reflect it back, and sound path and angle locate the flaw's depth and position, judged against reference sensitivity for rejection. Phased-array ultrasonics (PAUT) steer the beam electronically with many elements, producing a cross-sectional image in one scan and a digital record that can be reviewed later. Base metal near the joint is also scanned before welding to find laminations that could lead to lamellar tearing.
units.model: 斜角探頭 θ = 70°，聲程 S = 60 mm 時缺陷深度 d = S·cosθ = 60×0.342 ≈ 20.5 mm，表面距離 = S·sinθ ≈ 56.4 mm。60 mm 厚板第一跨（聲波到底面）的聲程 = t/cosθ = 60/0.342 ≈ 175 mm，掃描範圍須依此規劃。數值為教學假設。~For an angle-beam probe at θ = 70° and a sound path S = 60 mm, flaw depth d = S·cosθ = 60×0.342 ≈ 20.5 mm and surface distance S·sinθ ≈ 56.4 mm. In a 60 mm plate the first leg to the back wall needs a sound path of t/cosθ = 60/0.342 ≈ 175 mm, which sets the scan range. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 檢測前以標準規塊校正時基、折射角與參考靈敏度，並以含人工缺陷的對比試塊確認能偵測規定尺寸；掃描須從兩側、多個角度涵蓋整個焊道與熱影響區，記錄每個指示的位置、長度與評級，並由具資格的檢測員簽署。~Before testing, calibrate time base, refracted angle and reference sensitivity on standard blocks and confirm on a mock-up with artificial flaws that the required size can be detected; scan from both sides and at several angles to cover the whole weld and heat-affected zone, record position, length and rating of every indication and have a qualified technician sign.
units.failure: 若只從一側以單一角度掃描，平行於聲束的平面型未熔合可能完全不反射而被漏判；耦合劑不足或表面有焊濺物，也會使靈敏度下降，讓應拒收的缺陷看起來可以接受。~Scanning from one side at a single angle can miss a planar lack-of-fusion flaw lying parallel to the beam, which returns no echo; poor couplant or weld spatter on the surface lowers sensitivity so that a rejectable flaw looks acceptable.
units.misconception: 射線檢測一定比超音波更適合檢驗所有厚板焊縫。~Radiography is always better than ultrasonics for every thick-plate weld.
units.practice: 檢測程序書要指定探頭角度、掃描路徑、校正試塊與允收標準，相位陣列檢測的原始資料檔須保存並交給業主；檢測員資格（例如 ASNT 或 ISO 9712 二級以上）與檢測時間須記錄在報告中。~The procedure must specify probe angles, scan paths, calibration blocks and acceptance criteria, and raw PAUT data files must be kept and delivered to the owner; technician qualification (for example ASNT or ISO 9712 Level II or higher) and test timing go into the report.

units.anchor: 填角焊腳長量規~Fillet-weld size gauge
units.title: 目視與尺寸檢查~Visual and dimensional inspection
units.mechanism: 目視檢查是最基本也最常被輕視的焊接檢驗：焊腳尺寸、喉厚、餘高、咬邊、焊瘤、表面氣孔與弧坑裂縫，都可以用量規、放大鏡與良好照明找出來。巨型接頭中大量的填角焊承受剪力，尺寸不足會直接降低強度；咬邊與焊瘤則在焊趾形成缺口，降低疲勞強度。Kielland 平台的 6 mm 填角焊因焊道輪廓不良而降低疲勞強度，說明非主要受力的附屬焊縫也必須被檢查。~Visual inspection is the most basic and most often underrated weld check: leg size, throat, reinforcement, undercut, overlap, surface porosity and crater cracks can all be found with gauges, a magnifier and good lighting. Major joints contain many fillet welds carrying shear, and undersize directly reduces strength; undercut and overlap notch the weld toe and cut fatigue strength. On the Kielland platform a 6 mm fillet weld with a poor profile had reduced fatigue strength, showing that welds on non-load-bearing attachments must be inspected too.
units.model: 填角焊有效喉厚 a = 0.707·s，每 mm 強度 φR = 0.75×0.6×F_EXX×a。F_EXX = 490 MPa：s = 12 mm 時 a = 8.48 mm，φR ≈ 0.75×0.6×490×8.48 ≈ 1,871 N/mm；若實際只有 10 mm，a = 7.07 mm，φR ≈ 1,559 N/mm，強度少約 17%。數值為教學假設。~Fillet-weld effective throat a = 0.707·s and strength per mm φR = 0.75×0.6×F_EXX×a. With F_EXX = 490 MPa, a 12 mm weld has a = 8.48 mm and φR ≈ 0.75×0.6×490×8.48 ≈ 1,871 N/mm; an actual 10 mm weld has a = 7.07 mm and φR ≈ 1,559 N/mm, about 17% weaker. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以焊腳量規沿焊道等間距量測尺寸，記錄不足處的長度與位置，並依規範允許的局部不足長度判定；咬邊深度以深度規量測，焊趾輪廓不良處以磁粉檢查是否有裂縫；淬火回火鋼的最終目視檢查應在焊後規定等待時間後進行。~Measure leg size with a fillet gauge at regular intervals along the weld, recording the length and location of any undersize and judging it against the local undersize length the code allows; measure undercut depth with a depth gauge and check poor toe profiles for cracks by magnetic particle testing; final visual inspection of quenched-and-tempered steel should follow the specified waiting time.
units.failure: 附屬板件的填角焊常被視為「不重要」而不檢查，但它在受拉主構件上形成疲勞細節；Kielland 平台的斜撐裂縫被認為可追溯到 1976 年施工時的不良焊接，1980 年 3 月 27 日平台傾覆，212 人中 123 人罹難。~Fillet welds on attachments are often dismissed as unimportant and left uninspected, yet they create fatigue details on main tension members; the crack in the Kielland platform's brace was traced to poor welding probably dating from construction in 1976, and on 27 March 1980 the platform capsized, killing 123 of the 212 people aboard.
units.misconception: 非受力的附屬焊縫品質不重要，不需要檢查。~Welds on non-load-bearing attachments do not matter and need no inspection.
units.practice: 焊縫清冊要納入所有附屬件的焊縫，特別是焊在受拉或疲勞構件上的吊耳、托架與感測器底座；臨時吊耳拆除後要磨平並以磁粉檢查，紀錄位置供日後檢查。~The weld register must include every attachment weld, especially lugs, brackets and sensor mounts welded to tension or fatigue members; temporary lifting lugs must be ground flush after removal and checked by magnetic particle testing, with their locations recorded for future inspection.

units.anchor: 刨除修補與複檢~Gouge-out repair and re-test
units.title: 缺陷修補與重新檢驗~Defect repair and re-inspection
units.mechanism: 被拒收的焊縫要以碳弧刨或研磨把缺陷完全挖除，並以磁粉或滲透檢測確認挖除乾淨，再依核准的修補程序重新預熱與施焊，最後以原檢測方法重新檢驗。修補比原焊接更困難：挖槽窄深、拘束更高，同一位置反覆修補會讓熱影響區反覆受熱而劣化。I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋 2021 年斷裂的調查即指向製造時兩處寬大的焊接修補所引發的氫致裂紋，說明修補焊縫必須與原焊縫一樣受到嚴格控制。~A rejected weld is excavated by air-carbon-arc gouging or grinding until the flaw is fully removed, confirmed clean by magnetic particle or penetrant testing, then preheated and rewelded to an approved repair procedure and re-tested by the original method. Repairs are harder than original welds: the excavation is narrow and deep, restraint is higher, and repeated repairs at one spot reheat and degrade the heat-affected zone. The investigation of the 2021 I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge fracture pointed to hydrogen cracks from two wide weld repairs made during fabrication, showing that repair welds need the same strict control as the originals.
units.model: 缺陷長 60 mm，兩端各外延 50 mm 挖除，挖槽長 L = 60 + 2×50 = 160 mm；預熱範圍取各方向至少 max(75 mm, t) 且 t = 60 mm，預熱區長度約 160 + 2×75 = 310 mm。若同一接頭抽驗 40 道中有 3 道需修補，修補率 7.5%。數值為教學假設。~For a 60 mm long flaw excavated 50 mm beyond each end, the gouge is L = 60 + 2×50 = 160 mm long; with preheat extending at least max(75 mm, t) in every direction and t = 60 mm, the preheated zone is about 160 + 2×75 = 310 mm long. If 3 of 40 sampled welds in a joint need repair, the repair rate is 7.5%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每一處修補都要有修補單：缺陷位置與類型、挖除深度、清除確認方法、修補程序、銲工、預熱紀錄與複檢結果；同一位置第二次以上的修補須經結構工程師核准，並考慮以硬度或韌性試驗確認熱影響區未劣化。~Every repair needs a repair record: flaw location and type, excavation depth, method of confirming removal, repair procedure, welder, preheat record and re-test result; a second or further repair at one location should require the structural engineer's approval, with hardness or toughness checks considered to confirm the heat-affected zone has not degraded.
units.failure: 修補時未完全挖除裂縫末端，或為了快速完成而省略預熱，新焊道下方留下氫致裂紋；這類裂縫可能多年後才在使用應力下成長並造成斷裂。~Leaving the tip of a crack unexcavated, or skipping preheat to finish quickly, leaves hydrogen cracks beneath the new weld that may grow under service stress and fracture years later.
units.misconception: 修補焊縫只是把缺陷補起來，品質要求可以比原焊縫寬鬆。~A repair weld just fills a defect, so it can be held to a looser standard than the original.
units.practice: 修補程序要與原焊接程序一樣事先送審，修補後的非破壞檢測不得低於原檢測等級；修補紀錄與位置必須永久保存並標在竣工焊道圖上，作為日後營運檢查的重點。~Repair procedures must be submitted for approval in advance like the original WPS, post-repair NDT must be at least as stringent as the original test, and repair records and locations must be kept permanently and marked on the as-built weld map as priority points for in-service inspection.

units.anchor: 焊道地圖與檢驗報告~Weld map and inspection reports
units.title: 焊接紀錄、可追溯性與交接~Weld records, traceability and handover
units.mechanism: 每一道重要焊縫都應能追溯到鋼板爐號、焊接程序、銲工、施焊日期、預熱紀錄、非破壞檢測報告與修補履歷。這些紀錄在施工期間用來找出系統性問題，例如某位銲工或某個班次的拒收率偏高；在營運期間則讓檢查人員知道哪些接頭曾經修補、哪些附屬件焊在受拉構件上。Kielland 平台與 I-40 橋的事故都顯示，製造時的焊接缺陷可能在多年後才顯現，因此交接文件要讓下一代工程師找得到這些細節。~Every important weld should trace back to plate heat number, welding procedure, welder, date, preheat record, NDT reports and repair history. During construction these records expose systematic problems, such as one welder or shift with a high reject rate; in service they tell inspectors which joints were repaired and which attachments are welded to tension members. The Kielland platform and the I-40 bridge both show that fabrication weld defects can surface years later, so handover documents must let the next generation of engineers find these details.
units.model: 以紀錄比較銲工表現：銲工 A 焊 80 道、拒收 2 道，拒收率 2/80 = 2.5%；銲工 B 焊 60 道、拒收 6 道，拒收率 6/60 = 10%。B 的拒收率為 A 的 4 倍，應暫停其需求關鍵焊縫作業、重新訓練與考試，並把其已完成焊縫的超音波抽驗提高到 100%。數值為教學假設。~Records compare welders: welder A made 80 welds with 2 rejected, a 2/80 = 2.5% rate; welder B made 60 with 6 rejected, a 6/60 = 10% rate. B's rate is four times A's, so B should be stood down from demand-critical welds, retrained and retested, and B's completed welds raised to 100% ultrasonic testing. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接前隨機抽取數道焊縫，從現場焊道標記追溯到銲工、程序、檢測報告與修補單，確認紀錄鏈完整；並檢查竣工焊道圖是否標示所有修補位置、臨時附件移除處與需求關鍵焊縫。~Before handover, pick several welds at random and trace each from its site mark to welder, procedure, test reports and repair records to confirm an unbroken chain; check that the as-built weld map shows every repair, every removed temporary attachment and every demand-critical weld.
units.failure: 若焊接紀錄只以紙本存放在製造廠，工程結束後隨公司搬遷或結束營業而遺失，業主在數十年後發現裂縫時，無法判斷是單一缺陷還是同批焊縫的共同問題，只能全面檢驗。~If weld records stay on paper at the fabricator and are lost when it moves or closes, an owner who finds a crack decades later cannot tell whether it is an isolated flaw or common to a whole batch, and must inspect everything.
units.misconception: 焊縫檢驗合格後，焊接紀錄就沒有保存價值。~Once welds pass inspection, the welding records have no further value.
units.practice: 合約應規定焊接紀錄以數位格式交付業主，包含焊道地圖、銲工與程序對照、檢測原始資料與修補履歷；業主的維護手冊要指定需定期檢查的焊縫清單，並由結構工程師依修補與疲勞風險排定優先順序。~The contract should require weld records delivered digitally to the owner, including weld maps, welder and procedure cross-references, raw NDT data and repair history; the owner's maintenance manual should list welds for periodic inspection, prioritised by the structural engineer according to repair history and fatigue risk.

example: 設計練習：超高層巨型箱型柱 800×800 mm、板厚 60 mm，以全滲透焊做現場續接。(1) 受力：柱在風載下承受拉力 15 MN，斷面積 4×(800 − 60)×60 = 177,600 mm²，平均拉應力 15×10⁶/177,600 ≈ 84.5 MPa。(2) 材料：CE ≈ 0.44、板厚 60 mm，教學假設採最低預熱 110°C、層間溫度上限 230°C；以 30 V、300 A、300 mm/min 施焊，熱輸入 1.8 kJ/mm，須落在 WPS 範圍內。(3) 收縮：A_w = 1,300 mm²，每個續接約 4.5 mm，20 個續接約 90 mm，於柱段長度中預留。(4) 檢驗：70° 斜角探頭在 60 mm 板第一跨聲程約 175 mm；400 道焊縫抽驗 40 道、拒收 3 道，拒收率 7.5% 超過 5%，全面補驗其餘 360 道。(5) 若改變一個輸入：抽驗只拒收 1 道（2.5%），可維持 10% 抽驗，但拒收焊縫仍要追溯銲工並修補後複檢。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。~Design exercise: a supertall mega box column 800×800 mm with 60 mm plates is spliced on site with CJP welds. (1) Demand: the column carries 15 MN of wind tension over an area of 4×(800 − 60)×60 = 177,600 mm², a mean tensile stress of 15×10⁶/177,600 ≈ 84.5 MPa. (2) Material: with CE ≈ 0.44 and 60 mm plate, the teaching assumption is a minimum preheat of 110°C and a maximum interpass temperature of 230°C; welding at 30 V, 300 A and 300 mm/min gives a heat input of 1.8 kJ/mm, which must lie within the WPS range. (3) Shrinkage: with A_w = 1,300 mm², each splice shrinks about 4.5 mm and 20 splices about 90 mm, allowed for in segment lengths. (4) Inspection: a 70° angle probe needs a first-leg sound path of about 175 mm in 60 mm plate; sampling 40 of 400 welds finds 3 rejects, a 7.5% rate above 5%, so the remaining 360 are all tested. (5) Changing one input: with only 1 reject (2.5%) the 10% sampling can continue, but the rejected weld is still traced to its welder, repaired and re-tested. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.
history: 焊接在二十世紀中期取代鉚接成為鋼結構主要接合方式，也帶來新的破壞模式。1980 年北海 Alexander L. Kielland 平台因斜撐上一道附屬填角焊引發的疲勞裂縫傾覆，123 人罹難；1994 年 Northridge 地震後，多棟鋼造抗彎矩構架的梁柱焊接接頭被發現脆性斷裂，SEAOC、ATC 與 CUREE 組成的 SAC 聯合團隊研究至 2000 年，推動了需求關鍵焊縫的韌性、細部與檢驗要求。2005 年海灣大橋東段工程焊接遭指控後的獨立檢驗，以及 2021 年 I-40 橋追溯到製造時焊接修補的斷裂，都凸顯品保與紀錄的重要。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Welding replaced riveting as the main way to join structural steel in the mid-twentieth century and brought new failure modes. In 1980 the Alexander L. Kielland platform in the North Sea capsized after a fatigue crack grew from an attachment fillet weld on a brace, killing 123 people; after the 1994 Northridge earthquake, brittle fractures were found in welded beam–column joints of many steel moment frames, and the SAC Joint Venture of SEAOC, ATC and CUREE studied them until 2000, driving toughness, detailing and inspection requirements for demand-critical welds. The independent inspection after allegations about welds on the Bay Bridge East Span project in 2005, and the 2021 I-40 bridge fracture traced to fabrication weld repairs, both underline the importance of quality assurance and records. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: Northridge 地震發生於 1994 年 1 月 17 日，規模 Mw 6.7~The Northridge earthquake struck on 17 January 1994 with magnitude Mw 6.7
SAC 聯合團隊於 1994 年中由 SEAOC、ATC 與 CUREE 組成，研究計畫於 2000 年結束~The SAC Joint Venture was formed in mid-1994 by SEAOC, ATC and CUREE, and its program ended in 2000
Kielland 平台於 1980 年 3 月 27 日傾覆，212 人中 123 人罹難~The Kielland platform capsized on 27 March 1980, killing 123 of the 212 people aboard
Kielland 斜撐裂縫起於固定聲納凸緣板的 6 mm 填角焊，調查並發現層狀撕裂與冷裂~The Kielland brace crack started at a 6 mm fillet weld holding a sonar flange plate, and the investigation also found lamellar tearing and cold cracks
2005 年 FHWA 報告海灣大橋東段三塊鋼構試件的焊道符合或超過規範要求~In 2005 FHWA reported that welds from three Bay Bridge East Span steel pieces met or exceeded specifications
海灣大橋東段自錨式懸索橋於 2013 年 9 月 2 日通車，主塔高約 160 m（525 ft）~The Bay Bridge East Span self-anchored suspension bridge opened on 2 September 2013 with a tower about 160 m (525 ft) tall

耐震需求關鍵焊縫焊材常要求 −29°C（−20°F）時 27 J（20 ft·lbf）及 21°C（70°F）時 54 J（40 ft·lbf）的衝擊韌性~Seismic demand-critical filler metals are commonly required to give 27 J (20 ft·lbf) at −29°C (−20°F) and 54 J (40 ft·lbf) at 21°C (70°F)
AWS D1.1 對淬火回火高強度鋼的最終目視檢查，要求在焊後至少 48 小時進行~AWS D1.1 requires final visual inspection of quenched-and-tempered high-strength steels no sooner than 48 hours after welding

timeline.event: Alexander L. Kielland 平台因附屬填角焊引發的疲勞裂縫傾覆~The Alexander L. Kielland platform capsizes after a fatigue crack grows from an attachment fillet weld
Northridge 地震揭露鋼造抗彎矩構架焊接接頭脆斷，SAC 聯合團隊成立~The Northridge earthquake exposes brittle fractures in welded steel moment-frame joints, and the SAC Joint Venture is formed
SAC 計畫結束，成果成為耐震焊接接頭設計與品保規定的基礎~The SAC program ends, its results forming the basis of seismic welded-connection design and quality-assurance rules
海灣大橋東段工程焊接遭指控，FHWA 委託獨立檢驗並切取試件分析~After allegations about Bay Bridge East Span welds, FHWA commissions independent inspection and cuts samples for analysis
I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋繫梁斷裂，調查追溯到製造時的焊接修補與氫致裂紋~The I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge tie girder fractures, traced to fabrication weld repairs and hydrogen cracks
